title: Memory Traffic Generator
text: Generate traffic towards memory controller, 1 input, 1 output; {Show Memory Controller ports} shows input and output ports, {Memory selection} sets the between memory regions, {Request type} sets the between write or read, {Total burst requests} sets the number of burst requests to generate, {Burst size (bytes)} sets the size of generated burst transactions, {Time between bursts (s)} sets the simulation time between burst requests, {Allow simulation only parameters} sets the configure additional parameters for simulation, {First burst time} sets the simulation time for initial burst request, {Random time between bursts (s)} sets the range of simulation time for recurring requests, {Wait for burst done} sets the wait for burst-done signal before generating next, {Enable assertion} enables verbose information and {View performance plots} displays performance metrics. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: burstDone
ports.summary: End of burst and access to memory scalar

ports.name: burstReq
ports.summary: Request memory access from memory controller scalar

params.name: Show Memory Controller ports
params.values: Show input and output ports on (default) | off

params.name: Memory selection
params.values: Choose between memory regions PS memory (default) | PL memory

params.name: Request type
params.values: Choose between write or read request Writer (default) | Reader

params.name: Total burst requests
params.values: Number of burst requests to generate 100 (default) | integer greater than 1

params.name: Burst size (bytes)
params.values: Size of generated burst transactions 256 (default) | scalar

params.name: Time between bursts (s)
params.values: Simulation time between burst requests 1e-6 (default) | time, in seconds

params.name: Allow simulation only parameters
params.values: Configure additional parameters for simulation only on (default) | off

params.name: First burst time
params.values: Simulation time for initial burst request 10e-6 (default) | time, in seconds

params.name: Random time between bursts (s)
params.values: Range of simulation time for recurring requests [1e-6 1e-6] (default) | vector of the form [ min max ]

params.name: Wait for burst done
params.values: Wait for burst-done signal before generating next request off (default) | on
